errors.text_span: beginnt 2020 bei etwa -10 Mrd. US-Dollar, fällt bis Mitte 2020 auf etwa -60 Mrd. US-Dollar
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the 'Saldo' (balance) starts at -10 billion USD and then falls to -60 billion. According to the chart and the right y-axis, the first bar in 2020 is already at approximately -60 billion USD.

Describing the trend for 'Importe' (imports) after the 2022 peak as having 'geringe Schwankungen' (slight fluctuations) is an over-generalization. The chart shows a noticeable dip from approx. 290 billion to approx. 255 billion USD before rising again, which is more significant than 'slight fluctuations'.
